- The only CausalSmith imports you may add or retain are same-run modules under `CausalSmith.Substrate.FiniteDagNonancestorMarginalInvariance.*`. Paper/research modules and helpers from other runs are forbidden dependencies. If such a dependency is needed, leave the blocker and report it instead of copying the definition.
